metadata.note: Synthetic. No production data. Numbers from a planted-PHI corpus are a floor and a methodology demonstration, not a substitute for measurement on production messages.

scoring.caveat: synthetic planted-PHI corpus: a floor and a methodology demonstration, not production measurement
scoring.flagged_ratio: characters flagged per character of real PHI; both rules above can be gamed by a span that swallows a whole segment, so a ratio far above 1.0 makes that arm's recall and precision upper bounds
scoring.precision: a prediction counts as correct if it overlaps any gold span; over-prediction costs utility, not privacy
scoring.recall: a gold span counts as found only if a prediction fully covers it; partial coverage still leaks PHI
